    """Fill each row with the color of the nearest preceding nonzero row,
    carrying the last seen color downward (and using the last nonzero color

    colors = [row[0] for row in grid if row[0] != 0]
    if not colors:

    # Existing example has a nonzero color at the top; zero rows inherit the

    out = []
    color = colors[-1]
    for row in grid:

        out.append([color] * w)
